Technical SEO.title: Google Search Rolling Out google.com/goto Tracking Parameters
Technical SEO.summary: Google is rolling out a google.com/goto passthrough URL in search results, a feature first tested in July 2026. The move appears designed to prevent third-party tools and AI companies from scraping Google search results, though Google has not yet officially commented.

Technical SEO.title: Google Search Ranking Volatility Continues Post Spam Update
Technical SEO.summary: Google's August 2026 spam update ran from August 18 to August 21, but ranking volatility has persisted beyond its conclusion, with ongoing chatter in the SEO community and third-party tracking tools continuing to show elevated fluctuations in search results.

Technical SEO.title: What Is WebMCP? How to Prepare Your Website to Serve AI Agents
Technical SEO.summary: Moz explains WebMCP, how it differs from traditional MCP, and how site owners can implement HTML or JavaScript tools to prepare their websites for agentic AI search. The piece positions WebMCP as a key technical consideration for the shift toward AI agent-driven discovery.

Technical SEO.title: Google AI Mode Also Gains Link Carousels For Developing Topics
Technical SEO.summary: Google has extended link carousels for top stories and developing topics to AI Mode, adding carousels of web pages directly within AI Mode responses. The feature was previously available only in AI Overviews, where it launched in June.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: Judge In Penske Vs Google Says AI Situation Seems Really Unfair
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: The judge who previously ruled Google a monopoly stated in the Penske vs Google hearing that the AI Overviews situation seems really unfair, signaling potential legal and regulatory pressure on Google's AI-powered search features.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: AI Tools Recommend Brands But Cite Other Sites, Data Shows
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: A report finds that AI tools frequently recommend brands in their responses while attributing citations to third-party websites rather than the brand's own properties, highlighting a gap between brand visibility and citation equity in AI-driven search.

Digital Marketing / Martech.title: What it takes for AI to find, trust, and act on your brand
Digital Marketing / Martech.summary: The piece examines the conditions under which AI systems discover, evaluate, and act on brand signals, framing brand trust and discoverability as a critical strategic challenge in an AI-mediated marketing environment.

AI Search / GEO.title: AI Brand Preference Now Splits By Generation, Claude Leads Gen Z More Than 7-To-1
AI Search / GEO.summary: New data shows Claude's preference among Gen Z users now outpaces Boomer preference by nearly 8-to-1, revealing sharp generational splits in AI tool adoption. The piece also highlights that high AI consideration scores do not reliably translate into user trust.

AI Search / GEO.title: Spam Update, Generative UI In AIOs, Reddit Drop - SEO Pulse
AI Search / GEO.summary: This SEO Pulse roundup covers the August spam update, the introduction of generative UI within AI Overviews, and a notable drop in Reddit visibility within search results. It provides a concise briefing on intersecting algorithm and AI surface changes.

AI Search / GEO.title: Being the source AI quotes is the new position one and Google Search Console now shows you
AI Search / GEO.summary: The piece argues that earning AI citations is now the functional equivalent of ranking in position one, and notes that Google Search Console has added reporting to surface when a site is cited by AI search features. This has direct implications for GEO measurement and strategy.

AI Search / GEO.title: Mastering generative engine optimization in 2026: Full guide
AI Search / GEO.summary: Search Engine Land offers a comprehensive guide to generative engine optimization in 2026, covering how to structure content and build authority specifically for AI-answer surfaces. The piece is positioned as a practical reference for practitioners navigating the shift from traditional SEO to GEO.
